game.q: mardana is tied up by the hot oil. what does guru nanak do?

wrong.fight: no weapon. that wasn’t his way.
wrong.gold: no bargain either. he brought something better.

game.right: YES. no weapon, no bargain. he sang, and tradition says the oil would not boil.

end.line: a fierce man heated a pot of oil. the Guru sang, and the fiercest man in the forest came out new.
end.l2: the fiercest man came out new.

share: a forest, a pot of oil, and a song that kept it cool. the story on infinite hill
